title: Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage: Bed-Hold Nights in a Block Settled by Bank Draft
content:
**Held nights on a bed-hold leave and the bank draft (Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage).** A night away at midnight on a bed-hold leave is not a covered day: when the bed-hold records book a leave for the settled block's service month, its held nights inside the settled block come off the days the bank draft counts before the supplemental effective date, all of them when the last such night falls before that date, those from the first such night up to the day before the date when the date falls after the first such night and on or before the last, and none otherwise; when the month books no leave, none come off.

The leave is read from the resident's Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations records: the held days booked for the same service month as the settled block, from the first to the last day of that booked span. Only the nights of that span that fall inside the settled block are considered.

| Supplemental effective date compared with the held nights inside the settled block | Nights that come off |
|---|---|
| Falls after the last such night | Every held night inside the settled block |
| Falls after the first such night and on or before the last | The nights from the first one up to the day before the date |
| Any other position | None |
| The service month books no bed-hold leave | None |

*Hypothetical worked example:* the Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations records book held nights from the 22nd to the 24th of the settled block's service month, all inside the settled block.
- Supplemental effective date the 26th: all three nights come off.
- Supplemental effective date the 23rd: the night of the 22nd comes off.
- Supplemental effective date the 20th: none come off.
